Built **Emberdeep — The Hollow Below**, a complete two-player, pass-the-device dungeon game in `index.html`.

The party takes turns rolling a d20 to strike, use a class ability, brace, or heal. Players must clear four rooms—including a final dragon—while managing vitality and focus. The game includes responsive phone/tablet layouts, combat animations, an adventure log, room-to-room recovery, and a restart flow.

**Checks:** JavaScript syntax validation passed, and I verified a combat action in the browser. I also checked the mobile layout at 390px wide.

Assumption: “2 player” means local co-op with two heroes sharing one device. The game is self-contained; start it with a local static web server.
